info.title: Outlit Public API
info.description: Generated from Outlit Core's capability catalog and public protocol transport contracts.

409.description: Capability request conflicts with current state

422.description: Capability request could not be processed

activatedSince.description: Filter customers activated at or after this ISO-8601 datetime

hasActivityInLast.description: Filter customers with activity in the last N days

noActivityInLast.description: Filter customers with NO activity in the last N days

traitFilters.description: Filter by exact trait values using key/value pairs

search.description: Search by customer name or domain (case-insensitive)

ownerId.description: Filter customers by internal owner user ID

ownerEmail.description: Filter customers by internal owner email address

hasOwner.description: Filter customers by whether they have an owner

traitFilters.description: Filter by exact trait values using key/value pairs

hasActivityInLast.description: Filter users active within this window. Format: Nd, Nh, or Nm (e.g., '7d', '24h', '90m')

noActivityInLast.description: Filter users NOT active within this window. Format: Nd, Nh, or Nm (e.g., '30d', '2h')

search.description: Search by user email or name (case-insensitive)
Search internal workspace users by name, email, title, role, or territory

role.description: Filter internal workspace users by role metadata when available

managerEmail.description: Filter internal workspace users by manager email metadata when available

hasOwnedCustomers.description: When true, return only members who own customers; when false, return only members who own none

orderBy.description: Field to order workspace users by

customer.description: Customer ID, domain, or name to look up

include.description: Additional data sections to include in the response

timeframe.description: Timeframe for timeline and behavior metrics (default: 30d)

customer.description: Customer ID, domain, or exact customer name to look up

channels.description: Filter by event channel. Use values such as PRODUCT, COMMUNICATION, MEETING, CRM, BILLING, SUPPORT, IDENTITY, DOCUMENT, or SYSTEM.

timeframe.description: Relative time window (default: 30d). Cannot be used with startDate/endDate.

startDate.description: Start of time window (ISO 8601, e.g. '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with timeframe.

endDate.description: End of time window (ISO 8601, e.g. '2025-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Cannot be used with timeframe.

sourceTypes.description: Optional generic source types to restrict fact results to.

factTypes.description: Optional customer-memory fact type filters, such as CHURN_RISK, EXPANSION, SENTIMENT, or BUDGET. Anomaly detector fact types are not supported.

factCategories.description: Optional public fact category filters. Supported values: MEMORY, CUSTOM.

include.description: Optional best-effort expansions. Use include=['evidence'] to request evidence when available; unsupported include values are ignored.

limit.description: Slack replies per page (default 50, maximum 100). Ignored for other source types.

cursor.description: Opaque Slack reply cursor returned by a previous exact lookup.

customer.description: Customer ID, domain, or name to scope source listing.

participant.description: Participant email or name to filter source records.

provider.description: Provider identifier such as gmail, gong, or google-calendar.

hasTranscript.description: Filter call sources by transcript presence.

customer.description: Customer ID, domain, or name. Omit to search across all customers.

query.description: Natural language query or topic to search for.

topK.description: Maximum number of artifact results to return (default 20).

sourceTypes.description: Optional generic source types to restrict the search to.

table.description: Specific analytics view to describe. Omit to list all views.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response with the same filters
